fixture_corrections: RT speed comparison now uses independent identically seeded fresh games on flat turf. Sequential resets previously compared different native gait/RNG histories and rough-surface trajectories; speed tolerance remains unchanged. The independent rough-turf regression uses shipped roughness.

Production hand contact limits are unchanged.

limitations: Rendered tests run the Linux/X11 build with a virtual Xbox controller, not the Windows GUI or physical controller hardware.
Short match scenarios override the shipped 2700-second half duration; no full 90-minute soak is claimed.

Short rendered match scenarios recorded native tactical choices and keeper position/shot modes. Other tactical choices are covered by the contextual decision unit cases; the new keeper claim path was not forced in these rendered scenarios.
3691 procedural profiles and 14718 mirrored candidate pairs are parameter variations of existing clips, not newly captured animations.
Articulated bodies, capsule contacts and clothing remain bounded physical approximations; finite tests do not prove perfect collision behavior for every pose.
The 40-toggle regression exercises the snapshot synchronization correction with resets and clean exits; it is not full source AddressSanitizer coverage.
Kickoffs remain automatic CPU restarts; the human takes own free kicks, penalties, corners, throw-ins and goal kicks.
